test_title: PYST 10 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 15 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

"The bowler took three wickets** in the past four overs."**
solution:
The correct answer is '**in the last four overs**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "**in the last four overs**" is more suitable because it clearly indicates the time period that has just passed.
 
• The original phrase "**in the past four overs**" is grammatically correct but slightly less common
